C22F.fTerm:
CHANGING THE PHYSICAL STRUCTURE OF NON-FERROUS METALS OR NON-FERROUS ALLOYS (processes specific to heat treatment of ferrous alloys or steels and devices for heat treatment of metals or alloys C21D)

Note(s)

  • Surface treatments of metallic material involving at least one process provided for in class C23 and at least one process covered by this subclass are classified in group C23F 17/00.[2012.01]

C22F1/00\\.en: Changing the physical structure of non-ferrous metals or alloys by heat treatment or by hot or cold working
